_comment: Sensor Dashboard (viewer) configuration. Lists the same sensors defined on the Pi side so the dashboard charts them. Edit to choose which sensors appear and how they look — no recompile. Anything omitted falls back to a built-in default.
_sensors_note: Only the sensors listed here are shown, in this order. Use a plain string for defaults, or an object to override name/unit/colour/axis. Set visible:false to keep an entry on file but hide its chart. IMPORTANT: each id must match an id the Pi actually publishes (see the root config.json, and check GET /sensors on the API). A non-empty list here is treated as authoritative and suppresses sensor discovery entirely, so an id with no data behind it draws a permanently empty chart rather than being skipped.

sensors._comment: The MaxBotix (MB7389-100) in the standpipe, read over UART. The Pi publishes it as 'maxbotix_depth' — that is the only id for it, and the old 'MB7389_100_depth' entry is gone: the root config once carried both and a later commit consolidated them into this one. Kept visible because the sensor is part of the installation, but note it returns no data yet (GET /sensors does not list it), which matches the GPIO15/UART0 contention documented on the Pi side — the HC-SR04's TRIG line and this sensor's serial input want the same pin. Until that is resolved this charts empty.
sensors.name: Standpipe Depth
